title: Gaslamp Quarter to Little Italy Tour
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
All areas and surfaces are wheelchair accessible
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb: Learn about modern hotspots, centuries old history, and everything in between! You will leave this tour with a deep understanding of San Diego and a fantastic list of insider recommendations to enjoy. This tour begins by The Gaslamp Quarter, journeys through the Embarcadero and finishes in the foodie paradise of Little Italy (just in time for brunch!).
